editorial_article: 113, often referred to as "The One Thirteen," is a post-punk band based in Leeds, England. Formed in 2022, the group quickly gained a reputation within the local music scene for their high-energy live performances. The band is fronted by lead singer and guitarist Jack Grant, who leads a lineup that emphasizes a raw, guitar-driven sound characteristic of the contemporary post-punk revival. After establishing their presence through a series of digital single releases, the band expanded their discography in March 2025 with the release of their debut EP, titled To Combat Regret. The group has maintained a steady trajectory since their formation, utilizing platforms like Bandcamp to distribute their music to a growing audience while continuing to perform live.
editorial_bio: A Leeds-based post-punk band formed in 2022, known for their energetic live performances and their 2025 debut EP, To Combat Regret.
